itemListElement.name: Hindi Transcription in India: Free Audio to Text in 2026

mainEntity.name: How can I transcribe Hindi audio to text for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use Google Docs voice typing with हिन्दी selected, YouTube auto-captions for videos, or the free plan of an AI transcription tool. For meetings, Lynkk's free plan covers 5 notes a month with Hindi support. Test any tool on 5 minutes of your own audio first.

Yes. Google Docs voice typing supports Hindi in Chrome, YouTube generates Hindi auto-captions, and Google Cloud Speech-to-Text supports Hindi as a paid API. Google Docs voice typing works in Chrome, Edge and Safari, but it only transcribes in real time, so a 1-hour recording takes at least an hour.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Hindi transcription and translation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Transcription writes spoken Hindi as Hindi text. Translation converts Hindi into another language, such as English. Transliteration writes Hindi words in Roman script. Pick the right one before choosing a tool, because many people searching for English to Hindi transcription actually need translation or transliteration.

Some tools can. Lynkk has a Hinglish setting for meetings where speakers switch between Hindi and English mid-sentence. Many other tools expect one language per recording. Test with a real Hinglish meeting of 10 to 20 minutes before rolling a tool out, and check how it handles names, numbers and English terms.

mainEntity.name: Which app is best for Hindi transcription of meetings?

acceptedAnswer.text: For meetings, an AI meeting assistant that supports Hindi is the most practical choice, because it also summarises and lists action items. Lynkk supports Hindi and Hinglish on Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and in person. Workspaces can also keep data processing in India.

AI Hindi transcription is accurate for clear audio with one speaker at a time. Check names, numbers and English terms, and have a fluent speaker review anything legal, medical or published.
